rationale: No daily natural-gas price series exists in the catalogue (utility.fuel_cost.gas_per_mmbtu is monthly and ends 2026-05), so the closest testable proxy is whether weather-driven US demand anomalies (same-weekday 2025 baseline) coincide with Hormuz news shocks, compared pre/post war and around Hormuz events; caveats: seasonality, the war as common cause, and Hormuz-share is a news-attention proxy not price sensitivity.
